name: modrixcommerce/bot-protection
description: Enterprise bot mitigation and traffic defense engine protecting against scrapers, credential stuffing, fake registrations, checkout abuse, and inventory hoarding.
author: Modrix team

permissions.name: bot_protection.view_dashboard
permissions.label: View bot protection dashboard and live traffic

permissions.name: bot_protection.manage_security
permissions.label: Manage active security posture, mitigations, and queue

permissions.name: bot_protection.manage_rules
permissions.label: Create, edit, and configure bot defense rules

permissions.name: bot_protection.manage_ips
permissions.label: Manage IP blacklists, whitelists, and country blocking

permissions.name: bot_protection.manage_settings
permissions.label: Configure bot sensitivity, CAPTCHA, and alert integrations

permissions.name: bot_protection.export_reports
permissions.label: Export bot attack reports as CSV and Excel

settings.label: Enable real-time bot protection
settings.help: Analyze incoming requests and apply threat mitigations.

settings.label: Risk sensitivity level
settings.help: Controls how aggressively the heuristic engine scores suspicious behavior.

settings.label: Challenge threshold (score 0–100)
settings.help: Requests scoring at or above this threshold will trigger a CAPTCHA challenge.

settings.label: Automatic block threshold (score 0–100)
settings.help: Requests scoring at or above this threshold will be immediately blocked with HTTP 403.

settings.label: CAPTCHA provider
settings.help: Select which challenge mechanism to use when visitors need verification.

options.label: Interactive Security Verification (Built-in, No external keys needed)

settings.label: CAPTCHA Site Key
settings.help: Public site key for external CAPTCHA provider.

settings.label: CAPTCHA Secret Key
settings.help: Private secret key for external CAPTCHA provider.

settings.label: Storefront rate limit (requests/min)
settings.help: Max requests allowed per IP address per minute before throttling.

settings.label: API rate limit (requests/min)
settings.help: Max API endpoint requests per minute.

settings.label: Login attempt limit (per 15 min)
settings.help: Maximum failed login attempts before locking out IP.

settings.label: Prevent rapid automated checkouts
settings.help: Block bots that attempt checkout in under the human speed threshold.

settings.label: Minimum human checkout duration (seconds)
settings.help: Checkouts completed faster than this time are held for bot review.

settings.label: Prevent inventory hoarding
settings.help: Limit rapid add-to-cart operations across sessions from the same IP.

settings.label: Enable web scraping defense
settings.help: Detect and throttle scrapers harvesting catalog prices and product content.

settings.label: Block commercial cloud/datacenter traffic
settings.help: Challenge or block traffic originating from AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, etc.

settings.label: Email alerts for attack spikes
settings.help: Send instant email notifications when an attack spike is detected.

settings.label: Alert email recipients (comma-separated)
settings.help: Email addresses to notify during security attacks.

settings.label: Slack Webhook URL
settings.help: Incoming webhook for real-time attack alerts.

settings.label: Custom Incident Webhook URL
settings.help: Send JSON payloads to your SIEM or custom monitoring endpoint.
